links.outcome: Top-diagnosis accuracy of Head.AI versus other LLM platforms on the same vignettes
links.effect: Head.AI identified the top diagnosis in 89.5% of cases vs. 74-80% for comparators; ORs vs. comparators 2.04-2.86, all p < 0.01.
links.quote: The algorithm correctly identified the top diagnosis in 89.5% of cases (vs. 74-80% in comparators), with a citation rate >97% and calibration (Brier score 0.153).

unlisted_practices: Structured implementation of ICHD-3 criteria as a knowledge base to improve LLM diagnostic classification

screen.reason: The study validates the diagnostic accuracy of an LLM-based clinical decision support platform (Head.AI) across 315 expert-generated clinical vignettes compared to general LLMs, but does not test a specific deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
